It recovers more health than if eaten raw.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Roasted Wildberries are a variety of [[Roasted Food]], and they are created when [[Wildberry|Wildberries]] come into contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} The sweet taste of Wildberries is altered when they are roasted. Roasted Wildberries restore three-quarters of a [[Heart]] to [[Link]] when eaten. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Roasted Wildberries reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Wildberry|Wildberries]] to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. The process of roasting Wildberries results in their sweet taste becoming altered. When [[Link]] eats a Roasted Wildberry, he will regain three-quarters of a [[Heart]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Roasted Food * Wildberry }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
